itens.titulo: This might get Valakut banned in Historic
itens.resumo: Aneurin has a new take on Gruul Valakut in Historic, thanks to a new Reality Fracture card - Hexhaven Invigorator - and how well the combo with Mine Collapse and Roiling Canopy works: is this enough to turn this archetype into the Amulet Titan of the format?
